name: hand-limit-5
description: ⚠️ 09/09/2026: READ THE HAND LIMIT AS THE SIMULATOR'S BOUND, NOT AS A GAME RULE (C7). The table plays with NO limit and Dean found that positive; the shipped 7 exists because the legal-move enumerator cannot cost an end-of-turn discard without a ceiling. So this ladder sweeps the instrument as much as the game, and no number it produces describes the hand Dean is playing with. THE HAND LIMIT AT 5, AGAINST THE SHIPPED 7 (03/09/2026). The tight arm of the pair that brackets 7. Five is one card above the 4-card opening hand, so a seat is at its ceiling from the first Draw and every turn after it is a genuine choice about what to throw. That is the strongest form of the diminishing-return argument that took the limit from 12 to 7, and this arm is where it either shows up or is shown to be a story. READ, IN THIS ORDER: (1) THE BONUS MIX, four ways - Draw 1 / visit a neighbour / visit yourself / slot unspent. If tightening from 7 to 5 lifts the neighbour-visit share further, the limit is genuinely pricing the hook and 7 may still be loose. If it does not move, the mechanism is somewhere else and 7 should not be tightened again on this argument. (2) The DISCARD rate at the turn boundary: at 5 this is expected to bite nearly every turn, which is the definition of a tax rather than a ceiling - so a rising discard count alongside a flat visit share is this arm FAILING, not passing. (3) Game length and the delivery clock, because a hand that cannot hold freight is a barn that fills slower. (4) The build rate, which is the thing a 5-card hand can least afford. A CAVEAT ON THE INSTRUMENT: a tighter limit is also cheaper to enumerate, so do not read a speed difference between the arms as a design result. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
